season.name: Fall
season.line: What did the year produce, what does it owe, and who will share the bread?

movement.name: The Attention
movement.line: Hear the alarm while there is time to answer.

x: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have a rest, a memorial of trumpets: it shall be to you a holy convocation.

days.t: Sounded in remembrance before the Lord
x: And if ye shall go forth to war in your land against your enemies that are opposed to you, then shall ye sound with the trumpets; and ye shall be had in remembrance before the Lord, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

And in the days of your gladness, and in your feasts, and in your new moons, ye shall sound with the trumpets at your whole-burnt-offerings, and at the sacrifices of your peace-offerings; and there shall be a memorial for you before your God: I [am] the Lord your God.

days.t: With trumpets and the sound of the horn
x: With trumpets of metal, and the sound of a trumpet of horn make a joyful noise to the Lord before the king.
Sound the trumpet in Sion, make a proclamation in my holy mountain, and let all the inhabitants of the land be confounded: for the day of the Lord is near;

days.t: A day of trumpet blast and battle cry
x: a day of the trumpet and cry against the strong cities, and against the high towers.

days.t: An indistinct sound from the bugle
x: For also if the trumpet gives an indistinct sound, who will prepare himself for battle?
